title: NeuroListen (Listening to the Brain): sEEG auditory-reconstruction features from 5 participants, authors' per-trial HGA/LFS/BBS arrays
description: Derivative stereo-EEG (sEEG) feature dataset from five epilepsy patients who passively listened to spoken Mandarin Chinese words, Mandarin digits and English words. It provides the authors' per-trial 2 s arrays of high-gamma activity, low-frequency signal and broadband features at 200 Hz after bipolar re-referencing and exclusion of contacts with epileptiform activity. Stimulus audio and mel-spectrograms are included to support auditory reconstruction and neural speech decoding.
methods_description: sEEG was recorded with Sinovation SDE-10/12/16 depth electrodes (118-186 contacts per participant) on a Nihon Kohden EEG-1200 at 1000 Hz while participants passively listened to 2 s spoken words. Stimulus markers sent to a DC channel aligned stimuli with the recording. Contacts with epileptiform activity were removed and the rest bipolar re-referenced. High-gamma amplitude (70-150 Hz), low-pass (100 Hz) and broadband features were computed at 200 Hz and normalised within each 2 s window.
